title: Sunday · bad color, ii
logline: The second of the three the book keeps. The estuary. The paint too wet; the sky runs into the mud; the heron is a blot. He posts it anyway.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the estuary at dusk, the sky bleeding down into the water because the paper was too wet. A gorgeous accident he'll spend a year learning to do on purpose.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, an estuary at dusk where the sky's color has run down into the water, a beautiful accident, no figures, no words

panels.name: Sky

panels.composition: Tier 2: the heron. A blot with legs. The strip's first heron.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a heron on tidal mud rendered as a dark wet blot with two thin legs, no words

panels.name: Blot

panels.composition: Tier 3: the mud at low tide, the channels, the paint pooled in them like actual water. Posted Sunday 11 PM. The chorus, tiny, at the bottom edge: two stick figures.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, tidal mud channels with paint pooled in them like real water, two tiny stick figures at the bottom edge, no words
image.notes: The chorus is two figures this early.

panels.name: Posted
